## Clinical Disciplines & Protocols
1. Dental Implants: 3D CBCT bone mapping, surgical stent guides, Straumann & Nobel Biocare Swiss/German titanium and zirconia fixtures.
2. Invisible Orthodontics: Invisalign Clear Aligners with ClinCheck 3D video roadmap.
3. Microscopic Endodontics: Single-visit root canal treatments utilizing surgical operating microscopes (Zeiss optics), ultrasonic irrigation, and biocompatible bioceramic sealers.
4. Cosmetic Aesthetics: Minimum-prep E.max porcelain veneers, chairside Zoom laser teeth whitening, gum contouring with diode lasers.
5. Digital Restorations: 3Shape Trios intraoral scanning replacing elastomeric impression trays, Monolithic Multi-layered Zirconia crowns.

## Patient Safety & Zero Pain Standards
- Infection Control: EN 13060 Class-B European fractional vacuum autoclaves with Class 5 steam chemical integrators in tamper-evident sealed pouches.
- Painless Anesthesia: Computer-assisted local anesthetic delivery (The Wand STA) ensuring single tooth anesthesia without collateral lip or facial numbness.
- Facility Ambiance: Scandinavian acoustic wall insulation, HEPA medical air filtration, ceiling entertainment monitors, and essential oil aromatherapy.
